name: Quix Lakehouse Sink
shortDescription: Consume data from a Kafka topic and write it to blob storage as Hive-partitioned Parquet files, with optional Quix Lakehouse catalog registration.

Variables.Name: input
Variables.Description: Name of the Kafka input topic to consume from

Variables.Name: TABLE_NAME
Variables.Description: Table name for data organization and registration. Leave empty to use the input topic name.

Variables.Name: HIVE_COLUMNS
Variables.Description: Comma-separated list of columns for Hive partitioning (e.g. region,datacenter,hostname OR year,month,day extracted from TIMESTAMP_COLUMN). Prefix a column with ~ to make it a VIRTUAL partition: it still appears in the partition tree and is filterable, but is NOT written as a physical key=value/ folder and does not split files — a single file keeps every value of it, and the column stays in the data so row-level filters still work. Example: year,month,~driver folders physically by year/month and exposes driver as a virtual level. Leave empty for no Hive partitioning — every physical (non-~) column listed here must exist in the incoming message payload, otherwise writes will fail.

Variables.Name: TIMESTAMP_COLUMN
Variables.Description: Column containing timestamp values to extract year/month/day/hour from (only used when HIVE_COLUMNS includes one of those time components).

Variables.Name: SORT_COLUMN
Variables.Description: Optional column to order data by during lakehouse compaction, enabling ORDER BY streaming and file skipping. Leave empty to fall back to TIMESTAMP_COLUMN automatically.

Variables.Name: AUTO_DISCOVER
Variables.Description: Automatically register table in REST Catalog on first write

Variables.Name: QUERY_API_URL
Variables.Description: Lakehouse Query API base URL. Announcing each registered file there is what makes the lakehouse console's tree and QuixLab's lake watch react as data lands; the catalog registration itself is unaffected. Leave empty on Quix Cloud — the platform injects Quix__Lakehouse__Query__Url when the workspace has a Query API deployment. Set it for a self-hosted lakehouse. Notification is best effort: a failure is logged, never retried into the write path.

Variables.Name: QUERY_API_AUTH_TOKEN
Variables.Description: Bearer token for QUERY_API_URL. Leave empty to use the platform's Quix__Lakehouse__Query__AuthToken, falling back to the workspace SDK token.

Variables.Name: BATCH_SIZE
Variables.Description: Number of messages to batch before writing to storage

Variables.Name: AUTO_OFFSET_RESET
Variables.Description: Where to start consuming if no offset exists

Variables.Name: MAX_WRITE_WORKERS
Variables.Description: How many files can be written in parallel to storage at once (based on partitioning + batch size)
